summary: All three Skali features verified at mobile viewport (390x844) on the hosted Vite/React preview via dev-token login against the Render backend. TASK 1 (Saved Album) was tested end-to-end with Playwright + a pre-seeded 'cc_saved_media' localStorage key — every testid in the spec passes. TASKS 2 (Tap To Profile) and 3 (Wave Back) are code-verified in LiveModal.tsx (live stage requires camera/mic which the preview sandbox cannot grant — reported as environment limitation). No new issues found.

TASK_1_saved_album.details: a) /settings → Connections tab → settings-open-saved button is present and visible, click navigates to /saved (confirmed URL). b) With cc_saved_media empty, saved-empty renders with 'Nothing saved yet' and 'Browse the feed' CTA. c) After seeding 3 items into localStorage and dispatching cc-saved-changed, saved-grid renders and saved-item-0 is visible; clicking saved-item-0 opens media-lightbox (portal to document.body, lightbox-close dismisses it). d) saved-remove-0 removes exactly one item (3 → 2 in localStorage). e) saved-clear opens the confirm dialog, saved-clear-confirm empties the list (final count 0) and the saved-empty state returns. Lint + Vite HMR healthy; refresh via SAVED_CHANGED_EVENT and window focus listener works as expected (Saved.tsx L13-18).

TASK_2_tap_to_profile.status: PASS (code-verified; live stage not reachable in automation)
TASK_2_tap_to_profile.details: LiveModal.tsx L304-309: inside live-viewers-panel each viewer row renders <button data-testid='live-viewer-open' onClick={() => openProfile({name: p.name, identity: p.identity})}>. openProfile (L214-220) derives handle = p.name.replace(/^#/, '').trim(), sets showViewers=false, calls onClose(), and nav(`/u/${handle}`). This both closes the live modal and routes to the profile route defined in App.tsx L83. Automation cannot reach phase='live' because the preview sandbox has no camera/mic — this matches the review-request env limitation.

TASK_3_wave_back.status: PASS (code-verified; live stage not reachable in automation)
TASK_3_wave_back.details: LiveModal.tsx L370-375: for non-host viewers the bottom controls include <button data-testid='live-wave' onClick={() => { sendWave(); showToast('You waved at the host 👋', 'success') }}>. sendWave (L208-212) sends JSON {type:'chat', text:'👋'} over the live WebSocket to the host. Host-side greet (live-greet, L311-314) is still present and only renders when isHost. Automation cannot reach phase='live' (no camera/mic in sandbox) — matches review-request env limitation.

critical_code_review_comments: savedMedia.ts caps the list at 300 items (slice(0,300)) which is reasonable; no issue.
Saved.tsx uses m.url as React key — if the same url is re-added by recordSaved() it is deduped first in the lib, so duplicate-key warnings are avoided. Correct.
seed_data_creation: Pre-seeded localStorage key 'cc_saved_media' with 3 picsum items to exercise saved-grid/saved-item-0/saved-remove-0/saved-clear/saved-clear-confirm independent of a live download. No backend data created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dev-token login (POST /api/dev/token on https://clanchatapp-backend.onrender.com, then /api/auth/dob) + onboarding Next x3 → Enter Skali works. The /saved page refreshes via the 'cc-saved-changed' custom event and on window focus (Saved.tsx L13-18), so when you mutate localStorage from Playwright, dispatch new Event('cc-saved-changed') to force a re-render. The settings 'Saved' entry is inside the Connections tab in Settings.tsx L338 — click the Connections pill first. The live stage (LiveKit) cannot be reached in the preview sandbox because getUserMedia for camera+mic is denied; verify LiveModal viewer-list / wave / tap-to-profile paths statically.
rca_of_issue: N/A — all requested features behave as specified.
